references.text: The Sabbath commandment in the Ten Commandments, where Israel is commanded to keep the Sabbath holy as a day of rest.
The continuation of the Sabbath commandment as an eternal sign between God and the children of Israel.
Moses repeats the Sabbath commandment to the congregation of Israel.
The command to keep the Sabbaths, linked with holiness.
The Sabbath as a sign between the Lord and Israel, so that they may know that He is the Lord who sanctifies them.
The Sabbath given as a sign so that Israel will know that the Lord is the one who sanctifies them.
The Sabbaths shall be kept holy as a sign between God and the people.
The Sabbath commandment repeated in Deuteronomy with reference to the exodus from Egypt.
The blessing for those who keep the Sabbath and preserve the covenant.
Promises linked to keeping the Sabbath holy.
Nehemiah rebukes the people for profaning the Sabbath.
The final Sabbath rest awaiting God's people in the New Testament.
